items.title: [Google Play 中评] ★3 it's an awesome game with engaging lore
items.summary: it's an awesome game with engaging lore and characters that is quite generous at times but has a terrible management. Light is pretty known for the broken promises and I'd recommend checking discord for opinions (not reddit, it'd be bad advice. nothing good comes out of there) on just how bad he is at giving answers and sometimes taking decisions. it makes me feel lost because such a good game finds itself in a declining state and it doesn't seem to be an easy situation too. poor corpo

items.title: [Google Play 好评] ★4 I just started actually playing the game
items.summary: I just started actually playing the game after having had it installed on my phone forever now. and I will say, I regret not starting it sooner because so far it's already climbed into my top Mobile strategy games.. and the fighting actually has more strategic gameplay and abilities to explore than most similar games. plus the artwork is not only as beautiful as I expected but ab ok e and beyond with amazing character detail. but I just barely started so I may end up editing my review.🥹😳🫣

items.title: [Google Play 好评] ★5 One of the best games of the card genre
items.summary: One of the best games of the card genre - gacha is very generous, and gameplay can be of low or high complexity depending on one's play style. Different modes to choose from. The visual novel aspect is very well done, story is immersive!
items.author: Ron

items.title: [Google Play 差评] ★1 Started just before 2nd anni. Game used
items.summary: Started just before 2nd anni. Game used to be astonishingly generous, F2P-friendly, and tough-but-fair in its balancing. That all started going out the window following 2.5 anni, though, and the recent blend of power creep, nerfs, and overtuning has rendered it just another P2W gacha for whales only. Light is the Aeon of Deceit, sure, but the publisher is also a lethal blend of greedy and incompetent. (Imagine advertising a gacha on Facebook in 2026!)
